title: FloodGuard Household Credit on RentGuard Catch-Up Payments
content:
**Decision table — flood household credit on a RentGuard Renters Policy catch-up**

Flood household credit on the catch-up: when the customer holds a FloodGuard Private Flood Policy in force billed on the annual plan and at least one FloodGuard premium payment was received in the last 12 calendar months, 3.00 USD is taken off the catch-up amount; when the customer holds a FloodGuard Private Flood Policy in force billed on another plan, or with no FloodGuard premium payment received in the last 12 calendar months, 1.00 USD is taken off; when the customer holds no FloodGuard Private Flood Policy in force, no flood credit applies.

The records read are the customer's FloodGuard policy (its status and billing plan) and the payments received on that FloodGuard policy's premium account in the last 12 calendar months.

| FloodGuard policy in force? | FloodGuard billing plan | FloodGuard premium payment in last 12 calendar months? | Credit taken off the catch-up |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Annual plan | At least one | 3.00 USD |
| Yes | Annual plan | None | 1.00 USD |
| Yes | Any other plan | At least one | 1.00 USD |
| Yes | Any other plan | None | 1.00 USD |
| No | — | — | None |

*Hypothetical cases:* a customer whose FloodGuard policy is in force on the annual plan, paid 7 months ago, has 3.00 USD taken off; the same policy last paid 15 months ago gives 1.00 USD; a FloodGuard policy that has expired gives no credit.
